caption: The drawing features an arrangement of stylized botanical elements on a gray background. There are several swirling, arched branches with elongated oval leaves scattered across the composition, rendered in shades of gray and black. Among the branches are clusters of floral shapes, each consisting of multiple short, curved, red and black petals organized in a circular pattern. At the right edge of the drawing is a vertical scalloped border decorated with evenly spaced, small round dots and leaf-like marks, all in lighter gray tones. The background shows visible variation in tone, suggesting texture or shading, with faint lines and cracks running throughout.
